scope: deterministic reference engine with synthetic fixtures; no German production systems or personal data

results.name: Standard birth
results.proves: The reference engine can turn complete authoritative evidence into one service plan without asking the citizen to carry birth certificates between participating services.

results.name: Ambiguous family situation
results.proves: The reference engine asks only for the modeled missing evidence and does not proceed as though uncertainty were resolved.

results.name: Dangerous mismatch / authority gate
results.proves: A modeled consequential action is blocked when required human approval is absent.

doesNotProve: coverage of all German family situations
nextEvidence: Connect one real sandbox/test interface or realistic adapter contract, rerun the same golden cases at integration level, then measure completion time, correction rate, duplicate asks and exception burden with users or qualified public-service reviewers.
